thread:
Alesha (Partnerships): Heads-up — we're planning a breaking change to SDK auth defaults. Old header X-API-Key will be deprecated, new default will be Authorization: Bearer. Target deprecation ~8 weeks out. Need partner compatibility gating and rollout plan. @Sam K @Morgan any blockers?

Sam K (Platform): Could you paste the exact curl examples for both old + new so we can draft migration docs? Also: what's the minimum SDK version that will work after change?

Alesha (Partnerships): Sure — sample: 
```bash
# current (deprecated)
curl -H "X-API-Key: $KEY" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate

# new (recommended)
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```
Minimum supported SDK: v2.0.0 (we'll keep a compatibility shim for older SDKs for a limited window).

Morgan (Integrations): 8 weeks feels tight for some partners. Proposal: 
- Publish migration guide + code snippets this week
- Compatibility-gate in marketplace to flag SDK versions <2.0.0 as "needs update"
- 6 week mandatory migration window + 4 week extended monitoring where we allow shim but log mismatches

Julio (CloudShelf): We have several customers pinned to SDK 1.x via config. For enterprise partners we can get most to move in 6–8 weeks but request a 10-week org-level grace period. Can we do per-partner exceptions? :pray:

Evan (Eng): We can add a runtime fallback that accepts X-API-Key for N weeks and emits an audit log. Performance hit is minimal but it does add code path complexity. Suggest: fallback for 2–4 weeks only; after that we'll reject X-API-Key.

partners-bot: Reminder — add a compatibility-test job to partner-ci pipeline with matrix: sdk_versions=[1.0,1.5,1.9,2.0] and auth_headers=[X-API-Key,Authorization]. Also schedule a canary rollout to dedicated infra.

Alesha (Partnerships): Action items from here: 
- @Sam K to own marketplace gating flag + partner notifications (due in 3 days)
- @Morgan to publish migration guide + sample PRs for common languages (this week)
- @Evan to scope fallback shim and monitoring, include perf impact estimate (2 days)
- @Julio to collect partner exceptions and send list (today)
- partners-bot to create partner-ci job (automated)

Sam K (Platform): I'll add a marketplace UI badge "SDK: update required" and an API filter so partner onboarding flows surface this. Will also create a partner notices email template.

Morgan (Integrations): For release notes, let's avoid "breaking" in the headline — instead: "Auth header migration: action required by [date]". We'll include migration checklist and a one-click toggle for partners in marketplace to opt into an extended grace period.

Julio (CloudShelf): Noted. I'll get the list of pinned customers and estimate how many need help. If needed we can offer engineering migration assistance via a short engagement.

Evan (Eng): I'll prototype the shim today and push a canary to staging. If telemetry shows >0.1% error rate when shim is removed we should delay enforcement window.

Alesha (Partnerships): Thanks all. I'll draft the partner-facing timeline + FAQ and circulate in this thread before we post. If there are legal/compliance concerns about auth header changes (auditing, logs), loop in security. :thumbsup:

partners-bot: Noted — scheduled partner announcement draft due in 48h.

Sam K (Platform): Cool — will follow up with marketplace PR and create a short postmortem-style runbook in case of regressions.

Alesha (Partnerships): Closing the loop here later today with the formal plan. Appreciate quick responses.
